''See also: [[Empty Ghost Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|The [[Empty]] [[Ghost]], also referred to as the [[Hollow King]], is a dark [[spirit]] and a significant threat characterized as a hollow imitation of humanity. Recognized for his immense danger and past transgressions, he has been designated as the temporary successor to the [[Silent King]] and is classified as the fourth [[Dreadgod]]. This entity is associated with a [[hunger aura]] that bolsters the power of other [[Dreadgods]], such as the [[Wandering Titan]] and the [[Bleeding Phoenix]]. The [[Empty]] [[Ghost]] is known to exert his attention on individuals, though he does not always take direct action. His presence has caused rumors regarding the [[Twin Star Sect]] being a cult of [[Dreadgods]], and he is a figure for whom others have sworn oaths to combat.}}

== Waybound ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|Originally a name used by [[Malice]] to refer to [[Lindon]], the [[Empty]] [[Ghost]] is a [[Dreadgod]]-like presence that he is able to manifest. While rumors of this entity have circulated among the people of [[Serpent's Grave|Serpent’s Grave]], [[Malice]] herself harbored fears that the presence might follow her through a [[portal]]. The manifestation eventually triggered an intruder alert in [[Northstrider's oracle codex]], prompting the [[Monarch]] to intend to fight it. Because no single [[Monarch]] can face the [[Empty]] [[Ghost]] alone, the entity went into battle, during which time the [[Silent Servants]] began treating [[Lindon]] as the new [[Silent King]].}}
